messages:
jamie: Heads-up — ran into a weird auth+retry issue in the new Next.js starter template. Token refresh sometimes races and the SDK retries generate 401 loops. Repro on v0.3.1 SDK (js) when refresh token request is slow.

sara: ugh. can you paste minimal repro?

jamie: yes — simple fetch path in /api/generate with our SDK wrapper. snippet:
```
// server/api/generate.js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const out = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: req.body.prompt });
  res.json(out);
}
```
When the auth endpoint takes >500ms, client retries and then the refresh call happens twice -> second call 401s and client stops retrying.

michael: does this happen with python SDK too?

jamie: haven't tried python yet. seems like SDK parity problem — js retries kick in before refresh promise settles.

sara: ok can you open a repro repo? I'll try to reproduce locally. also include env var stub so we can simulate slow auth.

jamie: pushed a tiny repro: github.com/redwood/repro-next-auth-race (private). Added a flag SLOW_AUTH=true to simulate latency.

alexa: FYI I saw similar in an eval harness last week. Might be the request-backoff behavior being optimistic. I think we should: 1) ensure refresh is serialized per client 2) add jitter between retries 3) doc the expected token-concurrency behavior.

jamie: created draft PR removing parallel refresh + adding a queue: https://github.com/redwood/repro-next-auth-race/pull/2 — needs review :pray: 

devbot: CI — tests passed on node 18 (tests/refresh-queue.spec.js) :white_check_mark: 

sara: nice. can we also add a small note in devex/docs/starter-auth.md? onboarding folks hit this on low infra.

jamie: will do. also thinking of a tiny e2e in sample app to assert no 401 flakiness in CI.

michael: once PR lands, can we bump SDK patch and cut a release? cc @release-team

alexa: logging follow-up: add a unique request id to refresh attempts so we can trace in production logs.

jamie: ok, I'll add request-id and doc entry. thanks everyone :rocket:
